scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:actions && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: node scripts/files.mjs python | xargs -0 -r ruff check
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/files.mjs js | xargs -0 -r oxlint --fix && node scripts/files.mjs python | xargs -0 -r ruff check --fix
scripts.format: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 prettier --write --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && node scripts/files.mjs python | xargs -0 -r ruff format
scripts.format:check: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 prettier --check --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && node scripts/files.mjs python | xargs -0 -r ruff format --check
scripts.check:scripts: node --test scripts/ engine/wasm/ && uv run scripts/test_board_scripts.py
scripts.test:playwright: npm run app:build && npm run test:playwright -w app
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:data && npm run check:tables && npm run check:scripts && npm run check:codemap && npm run check:app
